content: Nandini followed up about her health policy, expressing concern over a premium increase she fears she can't afford. Suresh offered a one-time 5% discount to mitigate the rise. Nandini appreciated the offer but remained uncertain and considered letting the policy expire.

action_items: Suresh to apply a one-time 5% discount if Nandini accepts
Nandini to confirm whether she will continue the policy after the discount
